entry.title: Fiducio: paper accepted at TMLR, library released

link.title: Fiducio: paper accepted at TMLR, library released

entry.content:
Our paper Rethinking Post-Hoc Calibration in Semantic Segmentation has been accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). It studies two principles for post-hoc calibrators: translation invariance and decision preservation.

Alongside the paper we release Fiducio, an open-source Python library implementing the calibrators studied there, for classification as well as 2D and 3D semantic segmentation.

  • 📄 Paper & project page: fiducio-ai.github.io/Fiducio/paper
  • 💻 Code: github.com/fiducio-ai/Fiducio
  • 📦 Install: pip install fiducio
  • 🎉 Announcement on LinkedIn

Joint work with Kim-Celine Kahl, Bálint Kovács, Maximilian Rokuss, Klaus Maier-Hein, Xavier Coubez, Philippe Meyer and Sylvain Faisan — ICube Strasbourg, Université de Strasbourg, Institut Strauss and MIC @ DKFZ.
entry.summary: Our paper on post-hoc calibration in semantic segmentation is accepted at TMLR, and Fiducio, the accompanying open-source library, is out.

entry.title: Séminaires ICube IMAGeS (June 2026)
entry.content:
Invited talk given at the Séminaires ICube IMAGeS (IMAGeS team, ICube Laboratory, University of Strasbourg) on June 3rd, 2026.

Title: Toward Reliable Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation

The presentation covers recent methodological contributions on calibration and uncertainty quantification in medical image analysis, including multi-rater calibration, uncertainty estimation via model ensembles, and post-hoc calibration in dense segmentation, and their relationship with segmentation metrics.
entry.summary: Invited talk at the IMAGeS team seminar series, ICube Laboratory, Strasbourg.

entry.title: MICCAI Educational Challenge 2026 Tutorial
entry.content:
I prepared a tutorial for the MICCAI Educational Challenge 2026 on when model explanations can be misleading in medical imaging.

The tutorial is available as a static website, with the source code and materials hosted on GitHub.

  • Tutorial: When Explanations Lie
  • Code and materials: github.com/Kirscher/when-explanations-lie
entry.summary: Tutorial materials for the MICCAI Educational Challenge 2026 on misleading explanations in medical imaging.
